scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/app/android/.gradle-cache -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/app/android/.gradle-cache/gradle -v $PWD:/app -w /app/android adupangarai-android ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.android:sha1: docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -v $PWD:/app adupangarai-android keytool -list -v -keystore /app/android/.gradle-cache/.android/debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/app/android/.gradle-cache -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/app/android/.gradle-cache/gradle -v $PWD:/app -w /app/android adupangarai-android ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.android:release-sha1: docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -v $PWD/android:/a adupangarai-android sh -c 'keytool -list -v -keystore /a/keystore/adupangarai-upload.jks -alias upload -storepass $(grep storePassword /a/keystore.properties | cut -d= -f2)' | grep -E 'SHA1|SHA256'
